note: Layout per case: text_lengths[0] rows, condition image 0 (h*w latent tokens, h*w/4 slots in img_mask), text_lengths[1], ...; the target image follows the prompt. Latents are packed (tokens, channels), token = h * w_count + w. cache_k/cache_v = extract-mode prefix K/V (text and condition-image rows, post-norm post-RoPE). timestep is t in [0,1] (pipeline t/1000).
